note: Site BV009 on Tower Road, 1.74 miles from Aughwick Road on top of Tuscarora Mountain east of McConnellsburg: an open gravel and grass lot about 30 m by 20 m right beside the road, in full sun, that DCNR says holds one camper trailer or three vehicles with tents. A fenced communications tower compound stands about 40 m away and its access track leaves from the lot, so the site is neither private nor secluded. A stone fire ring is the only amenity listed. State forest roads are not plowed in winter. --Claude
summary: Site page re-read: open year round, bookable (nights offered Nov 2026, May and Jul 2027), $10/$15 + $6.50, 60 ft, back-in gravel, slight, 20-ft clearance, full sun. Imagery rendered (leaf-off): a gravel lot ~30 x 20 m at the pin on the south side of Tower Road, a small building 45 m W and a fenced tower compound 40 m SE reached from the lot. 3DEP level with the road (748 m). NHD: nearest flowline 169 m (intermittent). Pin matches ReserveAmerica and DCNR GIS (TrailerAccess 'Yes', '1 camper trailer of any size or 3 vehicles with tents').
flags: What it is: the gravel lot at the Tower Road communications / fire tower site, shared with the access to the tower compound ('Driveway Shared: Y'; 'Gravel and grass parking lot ... Easy access but visible from the roadway'). A reservable single campsite all the same; kept. Owner may want to know it is effectively a lot beside a tower compound.
Equipment categories on the site page: 'RV Site, Tent Site, Trailer Site'.
Bear Valley brochure (July 2026): the one site marked 'CLOSED for Evaluation and Maintenance' is BV008 Clarks Knob (Broad Mountain Road at Clarks Knob Road), not this site.

Access: US 30 (Lincoln Highway), Aughwick Road 0.96 mile, Tower Road 1.75 miles (OSRM). Surface, gates and weight limits unread (Overpass did not answer); the summit is at about 2,450 ft, so the unplowed-road caveat matters here.
Winter: the Buchanan camping page states no closure period.
Phone 717-485-3148 confirmed as the Buchanan district office (DCNR camping page and the Bear Valley brochure); apply.py does not write phone and no change is needed.
